name: prepare_provider_runtime
title: Prepare provider runtime
description: Prepare or update one fixed resource from the provider's approved runtime catalog after checking expected_catalog_revision. No arbitrary command, URL, path, global installer or model pull is accepted. Installed-runtime checks and connection-isolated runtime preparation are not permission to download unlisted resources. Missing dependencies, unknown digests for downloads, incompatible versions or unsafe SDK persistence remain unavailable with a safe reason. A provider has at most one active setup; an active runtime is not replaced. Return a provider_setup job; use get_job_status/cancel_job and list_providers.active_setup/last_setup. Repeating request_id returns the original job instead of downloading or preparing again. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument, not_found, configuration_conflict, busy, engine_unavailable, authentication_required, internal. All provider operations require the authenticated resident server; no implicit in-process or unauthenticated HTTP fallback is allowed.
